ex.zh: 人体的正常体温是36至37摄氏度。

ex.en: Sometimes it is cold as 26 degrees below centigrade.
ex.zh: 有时气温会低至零下 26 摄氏度。

tip: 通常说degrees centigrade；现代科学更常用Celsius。

ex.zh: 这株小植物一周长高了一厘米。

ex.en: Even a small rise in sea level, measured in centimetres, can increase flooding risks in coastal communities.
ex.zh: 即使海平面仅上升几厘米，也可能增加沿海社区的洪水风险。

source.label: 原 Word Atlas 学习示例，未在本次真题库中核验

senses.zh: adj.中心的 主要的 基本的 折中的 中枢的 n.电话交流 中央办公室 中心

ex.en: The idea that those at the bottom can rise to the top is central to America's ideas about itself.
ex.zh: 处于底层的人可以上升到顶层的想法是美国自我观念的核心。

ex.en: Central heating was present in every upper-and middle-class home by the second half of the 19th century.
ex.zh: 到 19 世纪下半叶，每个上层和中产阶级家庭都配备了中央供暖系统。

tip: central to表示“对……至关重要”，介词用to。

sourceRows.zh: adj.中心的 主要的 基本的 折中的 中枢的 n.电话交流 中央办公室 中心

senses.zh: n.中心 中枢 聚集点 vt.集中 置于中央 关注于 vi.居中

ex.en: I'm going to the city centre to buy a new phone today.
ex.zh: 我今天要去市中心买一部新手机。

ex.en: Research by Amanda Lenhart of the Pew Research Centre, a US think tank, found that the most passionate texters are also the kids most likely to spend time with friends in person.
ex.zh: 美国智库皮尤研究中心的阿曼达·伦哈特 (Amanda Lenhart) 进行的研究发现，最热情的发短信者也是最有可能花时间与朋友面对面交流的孩子。

tip: centre是英式拼写，美式写center；动词常接on。

sourceRows.zh: n.中心 中枢 聚集点 vt.集中 置于中央 关注于 vi.居中

senses.zh: n.世纪 一百年 成百的东西

ex.en: Over the next century, he predicted, the economy would become so productive that people would barely need to work at all.
ex.zh: 他预测，在下个世纪，经济将变得如此高效，人们几乎不需要工作。

ex.en: As schools have changed in the past century, the midday meal container has evolved right along with them.
ex.zh: 随着学校在过去一个世纪的变化，午餐容器也随之发展。

col: over a century ago｜一个多世纪以前
the turn of the century｜世纪之交
tip: 世纪序数比年份前两位大一：如1901—2000为20世纪。

sourceRows.zh: n.世纪 一百年 成百的东西

senses.zh: n.典礼 仪式 礼节 礼仪

ex.en: Music is often ceremonial: used in religion, ceremony, and celebration.
ex.zh: 音乐通常是仪式性的：用于宗教、仪式和庆祝活动。

ex.en: Tariq and his family were invited to South Dakota to attend the honorary ceremony at the State's Corn Palace.
ex.zh: 塔里克和他的家人受邀前往南达科他州参加在该州玉米宫举行的荣誉仪式。

tip: 指具体典礼时可数；without ceremony意为不拘礼节。

sourceRows.zh: n.典礼 仪式 礼节 礼仪

senses.zh: adj.确实的 肯定的 必然的 特定的 pron.某几个 某些

ex.en: While certain rare diseases can be easily identified, most potential health conditions cannot be identified by genetic testing alone.
ex.zh: 虽然某些罕见疾病可以轻松识别，但大多数潜在的健康状况无法仅通过基因检测来识别。

ex.en: We will probably have to change where we grow certain crops, as some regions get too hot.
ex.zh: 由于某些地区变得太热，我们可能必须改变某些作物的种植地点。

tip: 人作主语时，certain of表确信；certain to表必然。

sourceRows.zh: adj.确实的 肯定的 必然的 特定的 pron.某几个 某些

senses.zh: adv.一定 必定 当然

ex.en: Only a very few have shifted to cycling, and even those almost certainly won't cycle in Boston's snowy winters.
ex.zh: 只有极少数人转向骑自行车，即使是那些几乎肯定不会在波士顿下雪的冬天骑自行车的人。

ex.en: Unfortunately, this is reality, you can't have everything you want but a few are certainly achievable.
ex.zh: 不幸的是，这就是现实，你不可能拥有你想要的一切，但有一些肯定是可以实现的。

col: will certainly help｜肯定会有帮助
tip: 常置于实义动词前、be后；也可单独礼貌回应请求。

sourceRows.zh: adv.一定 必定 当然

senses.zh: n.必然 肯定 确定 确实的事情

ex.en: "One explanation for this finding is that possible awards may be more emotionally provoking than certainty awards," says Reimann.
ex.zh: “对这一发现的一个解释是，可能的奖项可能比确定性奖项更能激发情感，”雷曼说。

col: a degree of certainty｜一定程度的把握
tip: 表确信通常不可数；a certainty指确定的事。

sourceRows.zh: n.必然 肯定 确定 确实的事情

senses.zh: n.证(明)书 证件 执照 vt.批准 认可 发证书给...

ex.en: Some 65% of American men aged 62-74 with a professional degree are in the workforce, compared with 32% of men with only a high-school certificate.
ex.zh: 62-74 岁的美国男性中，约有 65% 拥有专业学位，而只有高中文凭的男性中这一比例为 32%。

ex.en: Of the endless troubles that come with being driven from one's home country, losing educational certificates may seem small.
ex.zh: 在被赶出祖国所带来的无尽麻烦中，失去教育证书似乎微不足道。

col: a professional certificate｜专业资格证书
tip: certificate泛指证明或资格证书，不一定是学位。

sourceRows.zh: n.证(明)书 证件 执照 vt.批准 认可 发证书给...

senses.zh: n.链 链条 项圈 连锁 束缚 vt.用铁练锁住 束缚 囚禁

ex.en: Over-hunting could lead to the disappearance of the whale population, possibly causing major problems to the global food chain.
ex.zh: 过度捕猎可能导致鲸鱼种群消失，可能给全球食物链带来重大问题。

ex.en: Panera Bread, an American fast-food chain known for its fresh ingredients, performed well, too, because it offers higher-quality food at lower prices than restaurants.
ex.zh: Panera Bread 是一家以新鲜食材闻名的美国快餐连锁店，其表现也不错，因为它以比餐馆更低的价格提供更高质量的食品。

col: a chain of events｜一连串事件
chain a bicycle to a railing｜用链条把自行车锁在栏杆上
tip: a chain of后接复数名词，表示相连的一系列事物。

sourceRows.zh: n.链 链条 项圈 连锁 束缚 vt.用铁练锁住 束缚 囚禁

senses.zh: n.椅子 主席 席位 讲座 要职 vt.上任 使担任(某事务)的主席主持

ex.en: There was one time when the doctor's receptionist came back and he was sitting on her chair.
ex.zh: 有一次，医生的接待员回来时，他正坐在她的椅子上。

ex.en: Now our students have a range of different seating options, including a floor desk, couches, stools, beanbags, and the traditional desk and chair.
ex.zh: 现在，我们的学生有一系列不同的座位选择，包括落地课桌、沙发、凳子、懒人沙发以及传统的课桌和椅子。

tip: chair作动词直接接meeting，表示主持会议。

sourceRows.zh: n.椅子 主席 席位 讲座 要职 vt.上任 使担任(某事务)的主席主持

senses.zh: n.主席 议长 会长

ex.en: Indra Nooyi, PepsiCo chairman, said the plan to make its products healthier was important for the company's growth.
ex.zh: 百事公司董事长 Indra Nooyi 表示，使其产品更健康的计划对于公司的发展非常重要。

ex.en: "One of the great things about freshman housing is that, with some exceptions, the process throws you together randomly," said Undergraduate Assembly chairman Alec Webley.
ex.zh: “新生住宿的一大好处是，除了一些例外，这个过程会将你们随机地聚集在一起，”本科生大会主席亚历克·韦伯利 (Alec Webley) 说。

tip: 性别中性的表达可用chair或chairperson。

sourceRows.zh: n.主席 议长 会长

ex.en: But this can be chalked up to the excessively high cost of their books—which has increased over 1,000 percent since 1977.
ex.zh: 但这可以归因于他们的书籍成本过高——自 1977 年以来已经增加了 1,000% 以上。

senses.zh: n.白垩 粉笔 v.用粉笔写 记录

tip: 画面联想：复用「blackboard」的相关场景；请以本词释义为准。

sourceRows.zh: n.白垩 粉笔 v.用粉笔写 记录

senses.zh: n.挑战 要求 需要 v.向...挑战

ex.en: However, figuring out what a company is like before you actually work there can be a bit of a challenge.
ex.zh: 然而，在实际工作之前弄清楚一家公司是什么样的可能会有点挑战。

ex.en: Sadly, the people who most need the help are least likely to take it — which raises a challenge for society as a whole.
ex.zh: 可悲的是，最需要帮助的人却最不可能接受帮助——这给整个社会带来了挑战。

col: meet a challenge｜成功应对挑战
challenge someone to a contest｜向某人发起比赛挑战
tip: challenge作动词可直接接观点，表示质疑。

sourceRows.zh: n.挑战 要求 需要 v.向...挑战

senses.zh: n.会议室 房间 会所 室 腔 vt.装入室中(枪膛) adj.室内演奏的

ex.en: At eleven, you're seeing Jeana Rivard at Meg Star and then you'll have a lunch engagement with Gaven from the Chamber of Commerce at one.
ex.zh: 十一点，你将在 Meg Star 见到 Jeana Rivard，然后你将与商会的 Gaven 共进午餐。

tip: chamber多指专用房间或封闭腔室，不是普通卧室。

sourceRows.zh: n.会议室 房间 会所 室 腔 vt.装入室中(枪膛) adj.室内演奏的

senses.zh: n.冠军 得胜者 拥护者 勇士 vt.保卫 拥护

ex.en: Isn't this the same crowd that rails against processed junk and champions craft cooking?
ex.zh: 这不是反对加工垃圾和拥护手工烹饪的同一群人吗？

ex.en: Then Jeff King, a four-time champion, reported a similar attack.
ex.zh: 然后，四届冠军 Jeff King 报告了类似的攻击。

col: a champion of equality｜平等的拥护者
champion a cause｜支持一项事业
tip: 作动词直接接宾语：champion a cause。

sourceRows.zh: n.冠军 得胜者 拥护者 勇士 vt.保卫 拥护

senses.zh: n.机会 意外 运气 风险 可能性 vi.偶然发生 vt.偶然发生 冒险

ex.en: Even though animals in nursing homes were illegal at the time, Dr. Bill Thomas took a chance.
ex.zh: 尽管当时疗养院里饲养动物是非法的，比尔·托马斯博士还是抓住了机会。

ex.en: As a result, Los Angeles now has its best chance in decades to combat homelessness.
ex.zh: 因此，洛杉矶现在拥有数十年来解决无家可归问题的最佳机会。

col: a chance to learn｜学习的机会
a good chance of｜很有可能
tip: 机会用chance to do；可能性常用chance of doing。

sourceRows.zh: n.机会 意外 运气 风险 可能性 vi.偶然发生 vt.偶然发生 冒险

senses.zh: n.改变 变化 零钱 vt. & vi.改变

ex.en: Furthermore, this theory cannot explain the change in trend in the U.S. working week in the 1970s.
ex.zh: 此外，该理论无法解释 20 世纪 70 年代美国工作周趋势的变化。

ex.en: The fierce divide between store owners and bike-lane advocates seems similar to our larger culture wars over climate change.
ex.zh: 商店老板和自行车道倡导者之间的激烈分歧似乎类似于我们针对气候变化的更大的文化战争。

tip: 表示“零钱、找零”时不可数，不能说a change。

sourceRows.zh: n.改变 变化 零钱 vt. & vi.改变

ex.zh: 例如，打高尔夫球的人会观看高尔夫频道。

ex.en: At Fox Broadcasting Company, he was a top advisor for years, known for his skill in helping to lead the launch of the company into sports, as well as the start of Fox News Channel.
ex.zh: 在福克斯广播公司，他担任高级顾问多年，以帮助领导公司进入体育领域以及福克斯新闻频道的开办而闻名。

tip: 动词常用channel sth into sth，表示将资源投入某处。

sourceRows.zh: n.海峡 渠道 通道 频道 方法 vt.引导 开导 形成河道 输送

senses.zh: n.章 回 篇 牧师的例行会议 地方分会

ex.en: Reading and comprehending longer books and chapters takes practice, and American teens are no longer getting that practice.
ex.zh: 阅读和理解较长的书籍和章节需要练习，而美国青少年不再进行这种练习。

ex.en: Furthermore, students will be able to purchase sections of the text instead of buying the whole thing, with individual chapters costing as little as $2.99.
ex.zh: 此外，学生将能够购买文本的各个部分，而不是购买整本书，各个章节的价格低至 2.99 美元。

col: a chapter in history｜历史上的一个阶段

sourceRows.zh: n.章 回 篇 牧师的例行会议 地方分会

senses.zh: n.性格 个性 品质 特性 角色 字符 人物 名誉 地位 adj. [剧](角色)代表某一特性的

ex.en: In fact, I thought it added character.
ex.zh: 事实上，我认为它增加了个性。

ex.en: For as long as there are homeless people, there is a tendency to blame the victims themselves for their condition—to see their failure to thrive as an issue of character, of moral weakness, of laziness.
ex.zh: 只要有无家可归的人存在，人们就会倾向于将自己的处境归咎于受害者自己，将他们的成长失败视为性格、道德弱点和懒惰的问题。

tip: 作“人物、字符”可数；作整体品质常不可数。

sourceRows.zh: n.性格 个性 品质 特性 角色 字符 人物 名誉 地位 adj. [剧](角色)代表某一特性的

ex.en: Openness—a characteristic defined by curiosity and a desire for knowledge—may also help folks pass brain tests.
ex.zh: 开放性——一种由好奇心和求知欲望定义的特征——也可能有助于人们通过大脑测试。

ex.en: The helpless ones believe intelligence is a fixed characteristic: you have only a certain amount, and that's that.
ex.zh: 无助的人相信智力是一种固定的特征：你只有一定的数量，仅此而已。

tip: 形容词常用be characteristic of，表示是……的典型特征。

sourceRows.zh: adj.特有的 典型的 n.特性 特征 特色

ex.en: As for the Brazilian artist's work, the authorities were annoyed but could find nothing to charge him with.
ex.zh: 至于巴西艺术家的作品，当局很恼火，但找不到任何罪名。

ex.en: Digital learning systems now charge students for access codes needed to complete coursework, take quizzes, and turn in homework.
ex.zh: 数字学习系统现在向学生收取完成课程作业、参加测验和上交作业所需的访问代码费用。

tip: 向某人收取某项费用：charge someone for something。

ex.en: Following a rescue by UK charity Cats Protection, the 4-year-old cat was later reunited with its owner, Mr. King's neighbor.
ex.zh: 在英国慈善机构 Cats Protection 的救助下，这只 4 岁的猫后来与它的主人、King 先生的邻居团聚。

ex.en: He often led pre-race parades at Aintree Racecourse and was a popular guest at charity benefits and public events.
ex.zh: 他经常在安特里赛马场主持赛前游行，并且是慈善福利和公共活动中的热门嘉宾。

col: donate to charity｜向慈善事业捐款
raise money for charity｜为慈善事业筹款
tip: 指机构时可数；指慈善事业或救济时不可数。

ex.en: "This is Aesop, the fabulist(寓言家), the man of these charming little tales, often told in terms of animals and animal relationships," he says.
ex.zh: “这是寓言家伊索，他创作了这些迷人的小故事，这些故事通常以动物和动物关系的方式讲述，”他说。

ex.zh: 对这些时刻的传统看法是，它们构成了青春迷人但无关紧要的副产品——应该被抛在一边，为更重要的品质腾出空间，比如坚持不懈、义务和务实。

sourceRows.zh: adj迷人的 可爱的

ex.zh: Google Ngram Viewer 图表显示，到 1993 年，书籍中提到的气候变化已经比全球变暖更常见。

ex.en: Since then, there have been a number of legal cases against companies involving paternity leave—including cases against JPMorgan Chase and Estee Lauder—which have helped put pressure on companies to make their parental leave policies gender neutral.
ex.zh: 此后，出现了许多针对涉及陪产假的公司的法律案件，包括针对摩根大通和雅诗兰黛的案件，这些案件向公司施加压力，要求其制定产假政策中性别中立。

ex.en: Among the goals, Carey said in an interview on Tuesday, is one that just about every global sport seems interested in chasing: increasing interest in the United States.
ex.zh: 凯里在周二的采访中表示，目标之一是几乎所有全球体育运动都有兴趣追逐的目标：增加对美国的兴趣。

tip: chase可直接接追赶对象，也可用chase after。

sourceRows.zh: n.追逐 追赶 追求 狩猎 争取 vt.追捕 狩猎

ex.zh: 该服务的设计初衷是价格便宜且易于运行，Dittoh 先生说。

ex.en: Some experts say there are still good reasons to believe cheap oil should heat up the world economy.
ex.zh: 一些专家表示，仍然有充分的理由相信廉价石油应该会提振世界经济。

col: a cheap alternative｜便宜的替代选择
tip: cheap有时暗示质量差；中性表达可用inexpensive。

ex.zh: 在五个实验中，研究人员给参与者布置了可以作弊的任务。

ex.en: In today's classrooms, students who cheat are rarely caught.
ex.zh: 在当今的课堂上，作弊的学生很少被抓到。

senses.zh: n.气候 风土 地带 风气 气氛

ex.en: The fierce divide between store owners and bike-lane advocates seems similar to our larger culture wars over climate change.
ex.zh: 商店老板和自行车道倡导者之间的激烈分歧似乎类似于我们针对气候变化的更大的文化战争。

ex.en: Plants are also, of course, our first defence against species loss and climate change.
ex.zh: 当然，植物也是我们抵御物种丧失和气候变化的第一道屏障。

tip: climate指长期气候，weather指具体天气。

sourceRows.zh: n.气候 风土 地带 风气 气氛

senses.zh: vt. & vi.攀登 爬 上升 n.攀登(处)

ex.en: Indeed, even before the steep climb in grain prices in 2008, the number of failing states was expanding.
ex.zh: 事实上，甚至在 2008 年粮食价格大幅上涨之前，失败国家的数量就在不断增加。

ex.en: "Ebike riders get the enjoyable part of cycling without the massive suffering of climbing huge hills."
ex.zh: “电动自行车骑手可以享受骑自行车的乐趣，而无需承受爬山的巨大痛苦。”

col: a steep climb｜陡峭的攀登路段
tip: 词尾b不发音；climb a mountain不加介词。

sourceRows.zh: vt. & vi.攀登 爬 上升 n.攀登(处)

senses.zh: n.钟 时钟 计时器 仪表

ex.en: They were complete clock watchers, while I would have liked a more flexible schedule.
ex.zh: 他们是十足的时钟观察者，而我希望有更灵活的时间表。

ex.en: My colleagues and I wondered whether midazolam, the most common sedative(镇静剂) used in surgical procedures worldwide, might interfere with the internal clock that protects the heart at night.
ex.zh: 我和我的同事想知道咪达唑仑（全世界外科手术中最常用的镇静剂）是否会干扰夜间保护心脏的生物钟。

col: watch the clock｜盯着时间等下班
tip: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

sourceRows.zh: n.钟 时钟 计时器 仪表

senses.zh: vt.关闭 结束 靠近 vi. 关 停业 搏斗 n. 完结 结论 adj. 靠近的 亲近的 几乎 密切的 势均力敌的adv. 紧挨着 紧紧地

ex.en: One straightforward reason close losers might outperform narrow winners is that the two groups have comparable ability.
ex.zh: 势均力敌的失败者可能比微弱的获胜者表现更好的一个直接原因是，这两个群体的能力相当。

ex.en: One common French custom of greetings is cheek-kissing, but it is mostly restricted to friends, close acquaintances and family members.
ex.zh: 法国人常见的问候习惯之一是亲吻脸颊，但主要仅限于朋友、熟人和家人。

tip: 动词读/z/；形容词和副词读/s/。

senses.zh: adv.紧密地 接近地 严密地

ex.en: "Each body starts the day differently—and those individual differences need to be researched more closely," Spitznagel says.
ex.zh: “每个人一天的开始方式都不同，需要更仔细地研究这些个体差异，”Spitznagel 说。

ex.en: The FBI worked closely with the Archives to determine that the letter was both authentic and definitely Smithsonian's property.
ex.zh: FBI 与档案馆密切合作，确定这封信是真实的，并且绝对属于史密森学会的财产。

tip: look closely指仔细看；stand close指站得近。

sourceRows.zh: adv.紧密地 接近地 严密地

senses.zh: n.布 衣料 桌布

ex.en: Plastic boxes changed to lined cloth sacks, and eventually, globalism brought tiffin containers from India and bento boxes from Japan.
ex.zh: 塑料盒变成了有内衬的布袋，最终，全球化带来了印度的午餐盒和日本的便当盒。

ex.en: Winning entries in past years have included a make-your-own cloth kit called Dove Bunting and a threefold, wallet-sized travel game with goals at each end, called Badoiiing.
ex.zh: 过去几年的获奖作品包括名为 Dove Bunting 的自制布料套件和名为 Badoiiing 的三重钱包大小的旅行游戏，两端都有目标。

tip: 布料义不可数；抹布可数，复数cloths；勿混clothes。

sourceRows.zh: n.布 衣料 桌布
